notes.subject: מאשרי
notes.rationale: Crux: KJV 'ol i blessim' (833 = tok gutpela long nem) vs JPS 'ol i lidim' (ol i ting i stap long יאשר). Mi holim pasin bilong bless.

notes.subject: מבלעים
notes.rationale: בלע = swarum/kakaikai olgeta — piksa bilong maun i swarum (luk Is 9:11).

translation: Na ol i givim gutpela nem long ol man bilong dispela manmeri, ol i makim ol i go nating; na ol ol i gat gutpela nem — ol i swarum olgeta.
